concerns.text: T015 defines 'Primary Baseline' as 'ALL other vaccines' (Non-COVID) but also creates a 'Non-COVID, Non-Flu' subset. The Spec (FR-007) and Plan (Phase 1) explicitly require the main analysis to use the 'Non-COVID, Non-Flu' baseline, while the 'Non-COVID' (all other) group is reserved ONLY for sensitivity analysis. T015 conflates these definitions, risking incorrect baseline usage in the main analysis.

T027 implements sensitivity analysis comparing 'Non-COVID (all other vaccines)' vs 'Flu-only'. The Spec (FR-007) and Plan (Phase 3.2) mandate comparing the 'Non-COVID, Non-Flu' baseline against the 'Flu-only' baseline. T027 implements the wrong comparison logic, failing to cover the required sensitivity analysis.

T030 (Unit test for temporal.py) is marked as rejected/missing. T032, T033, T034, and T035 depend on the existence of `src/analysis/temporal.py` and its logic. Without a task to implement `temporal.py` (FR-004), the temporal profile requirement is unmet.

T026 (Generate output/signals.csv) is marked as rejected/missing. T027, T028, T032, T053, T054, and T055 all depend on this artifact. The entire signal detection and reporting workflow is blocked by the missing task to generate the signals file.

T008 (Implement validate.py) is marked as rejected/truncated. T012 (test_validate.py) and T014 (download.py integration) depend on a functional validator. The 'Schema Validation Gate' (Plan Phase 0) cannot be executed without this task.

T039 implements a 5GB memory halt threshold. The Spec (FR-006) and Plan (Summary) define a single global constraint of '< 7 GB RAM'. The 5GB threshold is an arbitrary internal constraint not authorized by the spec, potentially causing premature halts and failing the FR-006 requirement.

T055 requires the report to include a 'Background Rate Unknown' disclaimer. The project notes explicitly state T024b was removed because flagging this is inconsistent with the ROR/PRR/IC methodology. T055 contradicts the project's own re-planning decision to omit background rate calculations.

T015 description contains a contradiction: 'Filter records where VAX_TYPE does NOT contain COVID-19 to define the Primary Baseline (Non-COVID Group)' followed by 'Create a subset... Non-COVID, Non-Flu Group'. The text is ambiguous about which group is the 'Primary Baseline' for the main analysis, conflicting with the Spec/Plan.
